text: No, we cannot confirm the forest has been fully intact since 2020. While 91.77% of the area was classified as forest in the JRC 2020 reference data, the remaining ~8.2% may have changed. The Hansen dataset shows tree cover existed in 2000, but annual observations (2001-2025) reveal potential localized changes exceeding the 0.5 ha minimum detection threshold. Without additional corroborating evidence for the entire area, the forest cannot be confirmed as entirely intact since 2020.
